paths.name: Cache path
paths.description: This is the place where all the generated thumbs and other cache files will be placed. Fast SSD is preferable.

paths.name: Root directory path
paths.description: Root path example where you should mount your photos library folder. Use this path when you will be adding a root dir in the web ui. Read only access mode is recommend.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Picthor is listening on port 5000 by default, map it to an available port on your unraid server

variables.name: Web address
variables.description: The url of your picthor installation. Usually: http://your unraid ip:picthor web ui port
